summary: Ultrapar Participações S.A. (via its parent Ultrapar Holdings Inc.) filed a Form 6-K disclosing board approval of a share buyback program for up to 18 million common shares (1.61% of capital stock), to be executed on B3 (São Paulo stock exchange). The repurchased shares will be used for stock-based incentive plans, held in treasury, or canceled—no capital reduction. No price, premium, or advisor is stated. The program runs until June 17, 2027, under CVM Resolution 77/22. Watch for execution pace and impact on float and incentive plan dilution.
